name: Unmake consumes the Paradox buff (#5027)
contract: Paradox 680946 reads "Casting Melt Reality now causes your next Unmake or Reverse Wound within 6 sec to become instant and cost 100% less mana", via the merged spell_proc fix that triggers buff 680947 off Melt Reality (806335, family 28 word1 512). 680947 carries two SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER effects (SPELLMOD_COST and SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME, both -100%, class mask word1 33554432 = Unmake 804418's own flags | word2 1 = Reverse Wound's own flags), but its own Spell.dbc record carries ProcCharges 0, so Player::RemoveSpellMods never dropped it after a cast: the free-instant window applied to every Unmake/Reverse Wound cast for the full 6 s duration instead of only the next one. ApplyAscensionClassMechanics19To25 now patches 680947's ProcCharges to 1 for the validated record, giving Aura::CalcMaxCharges one usable charge so the next Unmake cast removes the whole buff. Fails before the fix (the buff survives the Unmake cast), passes after.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Melt Reality's cast procs the Paradox buff
Casting Unmake removes the Paradox buff
